body:
Worker trap (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-19 23:45Z, met carrying w-33f4 from 9c698380 to 476c45c7). A carry by `git checkout --detach NEW` with the change staged can abort with "Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten" for dozens of paths you never touched, even under `-c core.autocrlf=false`, while `git hash-object --no-filters F` equals the index blob and `git diff --raw` is empty.

Cause: those files were last checked out under the repository's core.autocrlf=true, so the index recorded the CRLF size (e.g. 20145). Then they were LF-normalized for the freeze (19824 bytes). When the recorded size differs, Git treats the entry as modified without rehashing (ie_modified returns DATA_CHANGED for a nonzero ce_size), and `update-index --really-refresh` prints "needs update".

Fix, index-only, with no content change:
1. List the paths with `git -c core.autocrlf=false diff-files --name-only`.
2. Confirm none of them is one of your staged change paths.
3. Re-add them with `git -c core.autocrlf=false add -- <those explicit paths>`; the same blobs get fresh stat data.
4. Verify `git write-tree` is unchanged and `diff-files` is empty.
5. Then run `git -c core.autocrlf=false checkout --detach NEW`, which writes LF files that match the blobs, so the freeze sees no CRLF churn.
6. Verify your staged blob ids (`git ls-files -s -- <your paths>`) are identical before and after.

Related: freeze-crlf-working-files-trap.
